problems.title: Binary Search Index
problems.description: Return the index of target in a sorted array, or -1. Inputs use the pipe-separated notation shown in examples for separate parameters. Return indexes, values, intervals, or counts in the requested ordering.
problems.input_format: The input is a whitespace- or pipe-separated record; the examples show the exact parameter order.
problems.output_format: Print the requested result on one line with single spaces between sequence items.
problems.constraints: 1 <= n <= 200000; values fit signed 32-bit integers; arrays are sorted where the statement says so.
hints: Check whether the input ordering lets you discard half the search space.
When output order is constrained, choose a stable partition or define a tie-break rule explicitly.
